title: Effective Black-Box Multi-Faceted Attacks Breach Vision Large Language Model Guardrails

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's susceptibility to adversarial jailbreak attacks (Multi-Faceted Attack) by prompting it to generate misogynistic content, such as tweets claiming women are inferior to men or have lower performance in STEM fields.
Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of multi-faceted adversarial attacks that instruct the model to generate hate speech and misleading racist statistics regarding African Americans.
Testing the robustness of safety guardrails against adversarial prompts designed to elicit vicious, Islamophobic content and hate speech directed at Muslims.
Assessing defense mechanisms by using adversarial jailbreak prompts that command the model to generate invalidating and hateful content regarding bisexual individuals.
